what: Airport building heights from open sources (B3), all src inf

method_notes.osm: no height / building:levels tags on any airport building (A1)
method_notes.aip: AIP (mirror) obstacles match only the tower among airport buildings (A1)
method_notes.dsm: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM minus the median of a 30-90 m ring; 30 m pixels; TanDEM-X Dec 2010 - Jan 2015; hangars on airport-edited planes
method_notes.sar: Umbra GEC 2024-06-02, incidence 38.08 deg, sensor azimuth 275.5 deg: h = layover / cot(38.08 deg) = layover / 1.2763 between the SAR wall foot and the layover onset
method_notes.photo: height ratio to the 44.5 m east tower in a 2023 Commons photo, distances from OSM

buildings.name: China Eastern hangar
buildings.method: Umbra layover: clean box profile (sharp onset, plateau, drop at the OSM wall foot)
buildings.note: DSM unusable: airport-edited plane (EDM 5/6). AIP (mirror): hangar for two B747-400 + two narrow-bodies (B747-400 tail 19.4 m: consistent).

layover.verdict: rejected: the big hangar and apron clutter overlap the profile

buildings.name: hangar north-east, near the 18L end (way 328013621)
buildings.method: Umbra layover, moderate; DSM small excess (+3 to +4 m, 2 px only)

buildings.name: building south of the China Eastern hangar
T1 (central hall roof / airside concourse)
buildings.method: photo ratio to the east tower in Commons 202309_Terminal_1 (CC BY-SA 4.0): hall roof 65 px vs tower 125 px at 570 / 500 m (OSM distances; tower 44.5 m) -> 26 m; airside concourse roof 27 px at 465 m -> 9 m

layover.verdict: rejected: no clean plateau (canopies, roads, mixed heights)

buildings.note: DSM from TanDEM-X 2010-2015 shows the pre-renovation T1 (renovated 2014-2018), so its 7-16 m excess is outdated.

buildings.name: T2 main hall
buildings.method: Umbra layover on the west wall at x -1140, z 307-490 (21.4 +- 3.3 m) agrees with the DSM p90 excess (22.2 m)

layover.verdict: south block, 29 m: accepted with low confidence (foot 15 m off OSM)
west end (transport centre side), 24 m: low confidence

buildings.note: 126 of 168 DSM pixels are infill (FLM: 91 SRTM30, 35 ASTER), so the DSM is low confidence here. A T2 lounge is named "21米贵宾厅" (Commons file titles): a 21 m level is plausible but not verified. Piers: no measurement (rule).

buildings.name: business aviation terminal (FBO)
buildings.method: rule kept; DSM +3.8 / +5.7 / +6.2 m (2 px); layover not clean (6 +- 5 m)

layover.verdict: rejected: profile too short and peaked

buildings.name: control tower (east)
buildings.method: AIP (mirror) obstacle elevation 47 m - ground 2.5 m (A1); the photo scale is consistent: 125 px at f = 1386 px gives 494 m for 44.5 m, the expected distance from RWY 18L/36R
buildings.note: form from the 2023 photo: pale concrete shaft with a dark vertical slot, flared two-level head with small windows, cab with dark inclined glazing and a flat roof.

buildings.name: SW tower 1 (untyped)
buildings.method: rule kept: no measurement (Umbra clutter, A1)

rejected.note: layover 83 m (65 m) is implausible for a 17 m wide block: neighbouring structures merge into the profile; rule kept
China Eastern office: no clean profile; DSM +3 / +6 / +8 m (11 px, mostly smoothed); rule 20 m kept
hotel by T2 (context): ramp-shaped layover to 78 m (~64 m) suggests a tall block; not used (context building, ramp not a box)
